Is the new Audi Q9 more luxurious than an A8?!
Mat’s flown over to Utah to get his hands on the Audi SQ9!
It’s the first generation of the Audi Q9 & SQ9, and it sits right at the top of the Audi range. What’s more, it’s also the largest Audi ever produced!
So with that in mind, should you choose it over class-leading 7-seaters like the BMW X7 and Mercedes GLS? Let’s take a closer look, starting with the design…
